race.comment: HOOROO (2) sets the standard after winning on debut at Mackay as an odds-on favourite by just under three lengths in a Maiden. He still has to confirm it at Class 1 level, but the authority of that first performance gives him the strongest profile. HEROIC TALENT (5) has not won often, yet his Mackay fourth in Benchmark 55 grade came after a wide run and his wet-track record is a useful asset. CRUDO (4) earned respect with a four-and-a-half-length Birdsville Maiden win, though his previous heavy-track defeat at Nowra keeps the soft 5 as the question. BRUTAL LASS (3) made progress finishing midfield last start at Ipswich on a soft track when well supported, could add some value to betting.
